candidates.requirement: Before streaming a magicless zstd frame, set the decoder context to ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless while it is still at the header stage.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput consumes the seed prefix, creates or resets dstream, partitions the remaining bytes, and calls ZSTD_decompressStream. The stream header stage calls ZSTD_getFrameHeader_internal with zds->format.
candidates.failure_condition: For a finite input consisting of a seed prefix followed by a valid magicless frame, the target retains default ZSTD_f_zstd1. The format-aware parser then requires the ordinary magic number, so the supported magicless decoding behavior is unreachable. A concrete frame suffix is bytes 20 01 09 00 00 41: one-byte magicless header for content size one, one final raw block, and payload 41.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete target has no format setter, generic decompression call, or other setup that changes dstream->format. Random chunking and reset only feed bytes to the same default-format stream. The separate library test demonstrates that ordinary decoding fails and explicit format selection succeeds; it is not an alternate target route.
